beats.text: What if prices doubled every single day?
Because in Hungary in nineteen forty six it was even worse.
A bread that cost one coin this morning cost three coins tomorrow.
So people got paid and ran to the shop the same hour.
The government printed a banknote with twenty zeros on it.
But it was still not enough.
So they threw the whole money away and made a new one.
One new coin was worth a four with twenty nine zeros of the old money.
And the old banknotes were so worthless that street cleaners swept them off the road like leaves.
So next time your coffee costs ten cents more just ask yourself
